description: Permanently revoke this hook with its management token after explicit owner approval. New submissions are rejected; previously accepted deliveries finish. This does not cancel queued events and cannot be undone. Use get_destination_status first if you only need to inspect access.

hookId.description: Hook identifier returned by registration; preserve for all subsequent operations.

managementToken.description: Private management token returned by registration. Required for status, activation, revocation and credits; not the delivery token.

name: revoke_destination
title: Revoke Destination
